sql_model.form_descr: Raise, assign, work, resolve and close facility requests

rules.sql: SELECT unit_no FROM CCW_MEMBER_OWNER WHERE LOWER(owner_email) = LOWER(:user_email) UNION SELECT unit_no FROM CCW_TENANT_PROFILE WHERE LOWER(tenant_email) = LOWER(:user_email) AND tenant_status = 'A'

column.name: raised_by_email
column.heading: Raised By Email
column.descr: Raiser email (defaults to the signed-in user)

column.name: unit_no
column.heading: Unit No
column.descr: Unit the request is about (defaults from the user's unit)

validations.name: Unit exists
validations.message: Unit not found in Unit Master.

column.name: request_category
column.heading: Category
column.descr: Facility request category (drives the target resolution time)

validations.name: Priority is a listed value
validations.message: Priority must be L, M, H or U.

column.name: assigned_to
column.heading: Assigned To
column.descr: Facility team member (set before pressing Assign)

validations.name: Active team member
validations.message: Assigned To must be an active Facility Team Member.

column.name: target_date_time
column.heading: Target Date/Time
column.descr: Calculated: requested on + category target resolution hours

column.name: is_overdue
column.heading: Overdue
column.descr: Derived: Y when the target has passed and the request is not Resolved, Closed or Cancelled
column.sql_expression: CASE WHEN {CCW_FACILITY_REQUEST}.status NOT IN ('R','C','X') AND {CCW_FACILITY_REQUEST}.request_date_time + CAST({CCW_FACILITY_REQ_CATEGORY}.target_resolution_hours AS integer) * INTERVAL '1 hour' < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

column.name: status
column.heading: Status
column.descr: Open / Assigned / In Progress / Resolved / Closed / Cancelled; changed by actions

edit_lock.reason: Only Open requests can be edited.

validations.name: Open only
validations.message: Only Open requests can be edited.

validations.name: Open only
validations.message: Only Open requests can be deleted.

validations.name: No updates
validations.message: A request with updates cannot be deleted.

business_logic.spec: Return {"error":"A request with updates cannot be deleted."} when any row exists in CCW_FR_UPDATE for the payload REQUEST_NO; otherwise None.

business_logic.description: Assign the request to a facility team member
business_logic.spec: For facility team / management users only. Allowed only when STATUS='O'. ASSIGNED_TO (saved on the record) must be non-blank and an active CCW_FACILITY_TEAM_MEMBER (STATUS='A'), else error. Set STATUS='A'. Insert a CCW_FR_UPDATE line (next LINE_NO, UPDATE_DATE_TIME=now, UPDATED_BY=signed-in user email, STATUS='A', REMARK='Assigned to <STAFF_NAME>'). Notify the raiser (RAISED_BY_EMAIL) by in-app notification and email; notify the assigned team member (EMAIL of CCW_FACILITY_TEAM_MEMBER). If the request category is Security (REQUEST_CATEGORY or its NAME equals 'Security', case-insensitive) also notify every active team member with ROLE='S' (Supervisor). Return {"message":"Request assigned"}.

validations.name: Must be Open
validations.message: Only Open requests can be assigned.

validations.name: Assignee entered
validations.message: Select Assigned To (and save) before assigning.

business_logic.spec: Facility team / management only. Allowed only when STATUS='A'. Set STATUS='P'. Insert a CCW_FR_UPDATE line (STATUS='P', REMARK='Work started'). Notify the raiser by in-app notification and email, and the Supervisor(s) (CCW_FACILITY_TEAM_MEMBER ROLE='S', STATUS='A') if the category is Security. Return {"message":"Work started"}.

validations.name: Must be Assigned
validations.message: Only Assigned requests can be started.

business_logic.spec: Facility team / management only. Allowed only when STATUS='P'. RESOLUTION_NOTE from the payload is mandatory (error if blank). Set STATUS='R', RESOLUTION_NOTE, RESOLVED_ON=now. Insert a CCW_FR_UPDATE line (STATUS='R', REMARK=RESOLUTION_NOTE). Notify the raiser by in-app notification and email, and the Supervisor(s) if the category is Security. Return {"message":"Request resolved"}.

validations.name: Must be In Progress
validations.message: Only In Progress requests can be resolved.

business_logic.spec: Allowed for the raiser's unit (members/tenants of the request's UNIT_NO matched by email), facility team or management. Allowed only when STATUS='R'. Set STATUS='C', CLOSED_ON=now. Insert a CCW_FR_UPDATE line (STATUS='C', REMARK='Closed'). Notify the raiser by in-app notification and email, and the Supervisor(s) if the category is Security. Return {"message":"Request closed"}.

validations.name: Must be Resolved
validations.message: Only Resolved requests can be closed.

business_logic.spec: Allowed only for the raiser (signed-in email equals RAISED_BY_EMAIL, case-insensitive) or management. Allowed only when STATUS='R'. Set STATUS='P' (back to In Progress), clear RESOLVED_ON. Insert a CCW_FR_UPDATE line (STATUS='P', REMARK = captured REMARK, or 'Reopened' when blank). Notify the raiser, the assigned team member (EMAIL) and, if the category is Security, the Supervisor(s) by in-app notification and email. Return {"message":"Request reopened"}.

validations.name: Must be Resolved
validations.message: Only Resolved requests can be reopened.

business_logic.description: Cancel an Open or Assigned request
business_logic.spec: Allowed for the raiser's unit (members/tenants of UNIT_NO matched by email) or management, when STATUS is 'O' or 'A'. Set STATUS='X'. Insert a CCW_FR_UPDATE line (STATUS='X', REMARK = captured REMARK or 'Cancelled'). Notify the raiser, the assigned team member if any, and the Supervisor(s) if the category is Security. Return {"message":"Request cancelled"}.

validations.name: Open or Assigned
validations.message: Only Open or Assigned requests can be cancelled.

business_logic.description: Add a comment to the request
business_logic.spec: Allowed for members/tenants of the request's UNIT_NO (matched by email), facility team and management, on any status other than 'X' (Cancelled). Require non-blank REMARK. Insert a CCW_FR_UPDATE line with the request's current STATUS and the comment as REMARK; do not change STATUS. Return {"message":"Comment added"}.

business_logic.description: Notify the supervisor of a Security request
business_logic.spec: On action='add' only: if the request category is Security (REQUEST_CATEGORY or its CCW_FACILITY_REQ_CATEGORY.NAME equals 'Security', case-insensitive), send an in-app notification and email to every active CCW_FACILITY_TEAM_MEMBER with ROLE='S' (Supervisor) with the request number, unit, priority and description. Never blocks the save.
